payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all possible first moves (flipping k consecutive cards). For each, compute resulting spans of 0s and 1s using precomputed indices and binary search. If any move avoids immediate opponent win, game is draw; else second player wins.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks every starting position for a k-flip first move, evaluating post-move state via precomputed positions. No greedy selection; it directly tests all options to decide winner or draw.
